response.overview: Dark Karma is partly based on a true story involving two brothers; Dino & Chiko. Dino is a successful business man and Chiko is a mercenary and lives life the way he thinks he should live it. Then along comes Cormack - a rough tough bikie who thinks he can do what he likes and takes what he desires including Dino's wife Emily and daughter Justine. What will happen to Cormack and will Justice be served?
response.title: Dark Karma
